scripts.dev: bun scripts/banner.ts && bun run --cwd apps/web concurrently -n api,web,graph -c green,cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd ../api dev" "bun run dev:web" "bun run --cwd ../graph dev"
scripts.dev:api: bun scripts/banner.ts --api-only && bun run --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
